_about: D-547: exploited CVEs that affect a product only on some platforms, which no machine-readable feed says (KEV says 'on Linux', the CVE.org record lists the platform 'Linux', NVD's configuration names only the product). Reviewed by hand from the vendor's or the distribution's advisory: 'only' lists the platforms it affects (ids of findings/platform.go platformWords), 'affects' ends 'It affects only …', 'check' is what to look at on a device whose platform is not known, 'source' the advisory. A device or service whose OS, banner or package database names another platform is ruled out; one that names none keeps the finding with the condition (KF-4, KF-5). Read by modules/findings (platformLimits); checked by TestPlatformLimits_DataIsValid.

CVE-2026-123158.affects: OpenSSH built with musl libc and without PAM, such as Alpine Linux's openssh-server package
CVE-2026-123158.check: check the openssh package version on that device (apk info -v openssh-server): Alpine fixed it in 10.6_p2-r0 (edge), 10.3_p1-r2 (3.24), 10.2_p1-r1 (3.23), 10.0_p1-r11 (3.22) and 9.9_p2-r1 (3.21); until then set PasswordAuthentication no
